name: Build autonomous AI agents with Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI
title: Build autonomous AI agents with Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI
summary: Learn how Java developers can build production-ready autonomous AI agents using Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI. This post walks through tool calling, conversation memory, resilience patterns, and multi-agent orchestration, then deploys the agent to AWS with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
